# dsh-at-skill
English | 简体中文
A standalone DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds Skill invocation through `@name` without modifying Ha
eek Harness plugin that adds Skill invocation through `@name` without modifying Harness source code.
## Behavior
- Typing `@` in the conversation composer lists every user-invocable Skill available to the current

session.
- Typing more characters filters candidates by Skill-name prefix; settled catalog results a

re refreshed on the next request.
- Picking a candidate inserts `@skill-name `.
- Sending a whitespa

ce-bounded `@skill-name` token loads that Skill deterministically before the model step.
- Existing
`/skill-name`, `@subagent`, and `@plugin` behavior remains owned by their original plugins.
The Skill group uses menu order `2`, after existing `@` reference groups, so it does not change thei
r default Enter target.
## Compatibility
Requires Node.js 20 or newer and DeepSeek Harness >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0. This version is not compati
ble with the earlier 0.1.x Harness client.
## Installation
Clone the repository, install dependencies, and add the local package to the Web profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
It can also be installed directly from GitHub:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart `dsh web` after installation. The repository includes built `lib` artifacts so installing th
e package does not require a local Harness source checkout.
## Development
Run `npm ci`, then `npm run build` and `npm run check`. The build uses npm dependencies and does not
require a local Harness checkout.
## Limitation
Invocation is text-based and also matches tokens inside quotations and code blocks; it does not dist
inguish explicit picks from other text. If a Skill, subagent, or plugin shares the same `@name`, the
